them.zh: 这个技能让 agent 做的

steps.en: Copy the skill directory into your agent's skills folder, or paste SKILL.md into a chatbot
steps.zh: 把技能目录复制进 agent 的技能目录，或把 SKILL.md 粘进聊天机器人

steps.en: Ask to be taught a topic
Splits the topic into 4–10 subskills and asks 3–5 diagnostic questions, one at a time
steps.zh: 把主题拆成 4–10 个子技能，逐个问 3–5 道摸底题

steps.en: Shows a 0–5 skill map and proposes where to start
steps.zh: 展示 0–5 级技能图，建议从哪开始

steps.en: Narrows the question instead of giving the answer; levels up only after 2+ checks
steps.zh: 答错就追问得更窄，不直接给答案；两次以上检验才升级

steps.en: Runs a final mixed assessment once every subskill reaches the target level
steps.zh: 所有子技能达标后做一次综合测验

value.en: You find out what you can do unprompted, not what you nodded along to
value.zh: 你知道自己不靠提示能做出什么，而不是听懂时点过的头
